# Sha256

An incremental SHA-256 or SHA-224.

```rux
pub struct Sha256 {
    // private fields
}
```

Structural `Copy`; copying takes an independent snapshot of the digest state.

## Implements Digest

`Sha256` conforms to [`Digest`](/docs/api/crypto/digest).

<h3 id="update"><code>Update</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Update(self: &var Sha256, bytes: char8[..])
```

Adds `bytes` to the message.
Any split of the same bytes gives the same digest: whatever does not complete a block is buffered, and
the buffer is only compressed once it is full.

| Name    | Type        | Description         |
| ------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `bytes` | `char8[..]` | the bytes to absorb |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Sha256.rux#L149)

<h3 id="finish"><code>Finish</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Finish(self: &var Sha256, into: var char8[..])
```

Writes the digest into `into`.
The padding is a one bit, then zeros, then the message length in bits as a big-endian sixty-four bit
count. When fewer than nine bytes remain in the final block there is no room for that count, so the
block is finished with zeros and a whole further block carries it — the case that separates a correct
implementation from one that passes the short vectors.

| Name   | Type            | Description         |
| ------ | --------------- | ------------------- |
| `into` | `var char8[..]` | receives the output |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Sha256.rux#L182)

<h3 id="digest-length"><code>DigestLength</code></h3>

```rux
pub func DigestLength(self: &Sha256) -> uint
```

Thirty-two bytes for SHA-256, twenty-eight for SHA-224.

**Returns**: how many bytes a digest occupies

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Sha256.rux#L220)

<h3 id="block-length"><code>BlockLength</code></h3>

```rux
pub func BlockLength(self: &Sha256) -> uint
```

Sixty-four bytes, for both.

**Returns**: how many bytes the compression function consumes at a time
